question: Should OpenClaw accept SourceActor plus the SourceActor* scalar mirrors as the public generic channel attribution contract now?
rationale: The implementation is additive and tested, but it creates durable plugin SDK and prompt-context API that should reflect maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept SourceActor contract
options.body: Treat the documented structured object and scalar mirrors as the canonical attribution surface and land this PR after its prerequisites are ready.

options.title: Pause for narrower API
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want attribution to remain channel-hook-only or want a different public SDK shape before downstream memory work depends on it.

recommendation.title: Accept SourceActor contract
recommendation.body: Treat the documented structured object and scalar mirrors as the canonical attribution surface and land this PR after its prerequisites are ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Historical plugin SDK and channel boundary ownership makes this the best available routing candidate for the public API decision.
